reason: I already have more work than I can do, my wife runs the office and my relative takes calls and does quotes in the evening. I listen to the mailbox at lunch and that's enough; more requests coming in faster just means more people I have to say no to.
objection: I don't need more callers, I need fewer. Paying 99 euros a month to two young founders with no customers so a machine texts my customers on WhatsApp, I'm not sure my regulars would even like that.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 14-day check showed I was losing real emergency jobs or regular customers, and the 'ausgebucht' mode actually took the calls off my family's plate, I'd think about it, for less money.
